text:
Sam: Quick brainstorm: webinar handout should have a "cheat sheet" called 'Four quick truths' to counter cloud AI one-pagers. Short, punchy.
Ellen: Four truths? I'm thinking: 1) Serving != Model access, 2) Predictable performance beats peak benchmarks, 3) Operational cost is about unit economics not MSRP, 4) Deployment parity avoids long re-works.
Kai: Add a micro-proof under each truth. For #2 we can use 30d p99 data and a note on autoscaling smoothing spikes.
Vera: For inbound routing, propose 'fast track' tags on form: "enterprise-infer" and "compliance" so AE gets context. Also request a required checkbox for "deployment mode" (hosted/dedicated/private).
docs-bot: Generated skeleton doc at /marketing/webinar-assets/cheat-sheet-four-truths.md.
Sam: Great. Ellen, can you draft the micro-proofs? Kai, can you pull the perf snippets? Vera, coordinate with sales ops on fast-track tags.
Ellen: On it. I will keep each micro-proof to one sentence and include a source link.
Kai: Perf snippets will be live in the draft by EOD. We'll reference the 30d median/p99 dashboards.
Vera: Sales ops will add the fast-track tags if we provide the exact tag strings. I'll follow up with a PR to the form repo.
Sam: Keep language customer-facing but crisp. Avoid internal detail like 'prefix-KV' unless in a footnote. Thanks.
Vera: Also suggested webinar CTA routing: "Schedule enterprise pilot" button for enterprise-tagged leads, otherwise link to quickstart.
Sam: Nice. Meeting 11am tomorrow to review.
